title: Prove the selected P104 all-column caller algebra (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proves the exact-operator assertion `native_all_columns` for the pinned selected #6030 native layer and complete all-forward caller, for every positive column multiplicity and arbitrary spectator factors. A constrained quadratic Gauss-sum checker verifies full unitary overlap traces, retaining absolute phases without a tableau, distinguished column or dense operator matrix.

The source-bound composition covers 2,922 signed native/helper pairs, 208 intrinsic adapters, all 18 forward calls and 16 wrappers, 7,488 raw contacts, the complete 1,024-entry free-Laurent controller, and every whole-job boundary. Exterior scalar coefficients stay outside tensor powers. The 13,444 productive fields and 66,834 paid calls are unchanged.

**No new κ.** This proves the stated algebraic implication under explicit ideal owned-reset semantics. Selected-rate physical dispatch, allocation/erasure, compiler, precision/tape and analytic recovery remain separate; no selected record changes.

## Sources and reproduction

Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. SOURCES.json pins all seven live inputs by Git blob and SHA256. Extends the framework of #5442 and the native verification of #5974/#6043, retaining #6635's chart argument. #6546 covers the local word; this adds its assembled-caller algebra. It supplies the endpoint needed by #6878 without importing either unmerged package.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-native-tensor-closure
```

Expected: `PASS_SELECTED_NATIVE_TENSOR_CLOSURE`, `PASS_GAUSS_TRACE`, exact recipe-emission hash agreement and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

## Validation and remaining work

Executed on Python 3.12.14: normal and optimized complete checks, normal and optimized trace tests, full source-compiler recipe regeneration, and committed-byte/source checks. The trace oracle includes 16,933 small quadratic forms and 120 independent dense circuits. Twenty caller/native controls reject phase loss, wrong factor order, tensor-powered exterior signs, faulty adapters, aliases and source drift; ten additional controls exercise the trace grammar. Lead mathematical review and separate forward-Laurent/direct-character checks also passed.

Finite checks authenticate the fixed source identities; PROOF.md supplies the all-column theorem. The next obligation is a fully charged physical dispatcher with owned return and precision contracts, not another local chart census. This is AI-assisted review, not human or proof-kernel acceptance.
